headline: CodeMidas builds coding RL tasks from source code and reports gains on five external benchmarks
summary: The authors introduce CodeMidas, a pipeline that derives executable reinforcement-learning tasks from implemented functionality in open-source codebases, constructs execution-grounded tests, and filters environments using execution checks and solution rollouts. They report 5,545 training tasks from 3,185 repositories across 23 languages and 15 technical domains. Training MiMo-V2.5 with GRPO on this dataset reportedly improves all five listed external coding benchmarks relative to the same initial policy and evaluation settings. Examples include DeepSWE pass rate rising from 10.0% to 21.7%, Terminal-Bench v2.1 from 63.7% to 72.2%, and ProgramBench Almost Solved from 4.5 to 21.5. The authors report task-set disjointness from CodeMidas Val and the five external benchmark sets. These are author-reported results for one model/training setup, not an independent reproduction or general scaling law.
